tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search the Shelfclub book catalog by title or author name. Returns up to 10 books, each with its Shelfclub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and machine-generated mood, vibe, pace and genre tags.

tools.name: find_books_by_mood
tools.description: Find books in the Shelfclub catalog by mood, vibe, pace and genre tags. At least one tag is needed. Books that carry every requested tag are listed first, most read first; when there are fewer of those than asked for, books that carry some of the tags follow, and `matchAll` says how many of the book

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Look up one book in the Shelfclub catalog, by its Shelfclub id or by ISBN. Returns its description, authors, reader rating, series, an edition (ISBN, page count, publisher, publication date, language), its shelfclub.app link, and machine-generated mood, vibe, pace and genre tags. A lookup by id also

tools.name: get_similar_books
tools.description: List the books in the Shelfclub catalog whose mood, vibe, pace and genre tags overlap most with those of a given book. The tags are machine-generated, and a book that has none has no similar books. Returns up to 10 books, each with its Shelfclub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, tags

tools.name: get_trending_books
tools.description: List the books trending on Shelfclub: the books its readers have been shelving come first, then the catalog's most widely read books. Returns up to 10 books, each with its Shelfclub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and machine-generated mood, vibe and pace tags.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Look up an author in the Shelfclub catalog by Shelfclub author id, which get_book returns for the authors of a book. Returns the author's name, biography, birth and death dates and shelfclub.app link. With `include_books`, also returns up to 10 of their books, the most recently published first, each
